approvalReviewHistory.readOnlyWriteSiteAudit: AST audit showed leaf() only reads the frozen JSON and appends proposed old/new values to in-memory evidenceIssues; it never writes author files. Only put() writes owned report/receipt. Exact verifier final shared report is intercepted.
approvalReviewHistory.saferRetry: Fail-closed Python audit hook permits writes only to the exact owned northern_routes.json and northern_routes-review-check-receipt.json, rejects filesystem mutations, and retains unchanged actual validation logic.

8: Take MacKreel's Moonshine to Brewmeister Bilger in Southshore.

actualReplyMarkup.complete: Ah, nothing like Foggy MacKreel's Moonshine to warm you up on a brisk day!  And here I was thinking the little bugger was going to be overdue on his bills again. Thank you, friend!  Many thanks indeed!

8: Rhag Garmason wants you to locate Ol' Rustlocke.

actualReplyMarkup.complete: You search the tiny, dwarven corpse.  Engraved into the helmet you can clearly read: Ebenezer Rustlocke.

8: Report back to Rhag Garmason and show him the parchment you found on Rustlocke's corpse.

actualReplyMarkup.complete: Oh my, the news is grave....

8: Destroy the cache of explosives.

actualReplyMarkup.progress: The cache of explosives must be destroyed!
actualReplyMarkup.complete:
The remaining bridge is saved!  You have done a great service to King Magni and the people of Khaz Modan.

Now if we can only hold out long enough for reinforcements to show...

lines: Renamed from Plea To The Alliance

8: Seek out Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.

actualReplyMarkup.complete:
My condolences go out to Longbraid and his brave soldiers.  The news of the Thandol Span tragedy and the fall of Dun Modr hangs heavy in my heart.

But Stromgarde has fallen!  Hence our presence here at Refuge Pointe.  We are faced with retaking our own great city.

Honor and duty require that we do not leave the Highlands until Stromgarde raises the mighty banner of the King once again. I will send word to Longbraid that he is on his own...

8: Search for Corma's partner Essene.

actualReplyMarkup.complete:
Corma sent you? That's great news!

When the Dark Irons ambushed us, we were separated, and I hit my head and couldn't tell which direction I was going. I wound up here and I've been living out of the supplies in my bag for the last few days. Now that you've made it past the Dark Irons, though, it may be possible for me to make my escape.

I just have to gather my things and take a moment to catch my senses, and I'll figure out a way to escape!

She never gave up on me. What a lovely heart.

8: Bring back Essene's Necklace, Essene's Spellbook, and Essene's Waterskin.

actualReplyMarkup.progress: Just relacing my boots! Any luck getting past those Dark Irons and finding my things?
actualReplyMarkup.complete:
You got my book! And my waterskin! And my necklace! Oh, good fortune finds me today... thank you so much.

I'd better make sure everything is intact!

8: Bring Essene's note back to Corma Villard.

actualReplyMarkup.progress: Have you found any sign of her?
actualReplyMarkup.complete:
She's alive? She's alive!

Let me see this note... "Dear Corma..." mhmm... oh, blessed day! Thank the Light!

I can never thank you enough for reuniting us. I can't wait until she makes it back here!

You've done a wonderful service for us both.

8: Retrieve 3 Stolen Explosives from the Dark Iron Dwarf camps.

actualReplyMarkup.progress: This war against the Dark Irons just keeps going on and on!
actualReplyMarkup.complete:
Ach, that's a load off me mind. At least the Dark Irons won't be able to roll a bomb-cart into our wagons... or lob 'em in a trebuchet... or roll 'em down the hill at us... or feed 'em tae slimes and then let the slimes loose near are camp and set 'em on fire.

Now we just have tae make sure the powder stays dry!

Thanks!

8: Kill 12 Syndicate Footpads and 8 Syndicate Thieves, then return to Magistrate Henry Maleb in Southshore.

progress.reason: Primary field absent; secondary independently exposes exact state. No primary progress duplicated as offer.

actualReplyMarkup.complete:
Thank you, <name>.  Although they may still be lurking about, we hope that some of the thieves and footpads you slew were responsible for the last magistrate's death.  But even if they weren't, the Syndicate is a taint on this land and a stain on the human race.  

Their deaths are welcome to Southshore.

lines: Rewards: adds Choice of Ethereal Mantle
notShown: Rewards: adds Choice of Ethereal Mantle

8: Retrieve Deathguard Humbert's sword from Dun Garok and return it to him in Tarren Mill.

actualReplyMarkup.progress: Were you able to retrieve my sword, <name>?  High Executor Darthalia will hang me from the rafters if she discovers my folly.
actualReplyMarkup.complete:
You found it!

Ah, I feel so complete with my precious sword back in my hand.  Many thanks to you!

8: Retrieve Helcular's Rod from the Yeti and bring it back to Novice Thaivand in Tarren Mill.

actualReplyMarkup.progress: Have you recovered Helcular's Rod yet?  There are so many Yeti in this region, it will be very difficult to locate.  But we must have it in order to proceed.
actualReplyMarkup.complete: You found it!  Most excellent, <name>!

8: Charge the Rod of Helcular with the powers of the Flame of Azel, Flame of Veraz and the Flame of Uzel.
Drive the charged rod into Helcular's grave in Southshore.

actualReplyMarkup.progress: Helcular's grave teems with a mystical energy.
actualReplyMarkup.complete: A great rumbling emanates from the ground.

8: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Chef Jessen in Southshore.

actualReplyMarkup.progress: Any luck finding the ingredients?  I'll tell you, this territory isn't the peaceful place it once was.  Ah, if only this unrest never occurred. . .
actualReplyMarkup.complete: Everyone will be so pleased: Chef Jessen's Soothing Turtle Bisque is served once again!

8: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill.

actualReplyMarkup.progress: Any luck finding the ingredients?  I'll tell you, the alliance maggots are far too numerous in this area now... In my opinion, they have come far too close already...
actualReplyMarkup.complete: My soothing turtle bisque will keep you warm on a cold night... if you care about that kind of thing.

8: Bring 10 Worn Stone Tokens to Keeper Bel'varil in Tarren Mill.

actualReplyMarkup.progress: Do you have the Worn Stone Tokens, <name>?  The Magus is eager to unlock their secrets.
actualReplyMarkup.complete:
These will do nicely.  Although it looks like their magic is faded, it would be best if the Magus' initial experiments were on inert specimens such as these.

Thank you, <name>.

8: Bring 4 Bracers of Earth Binding to Keeper Bel'varil in Tarren Mill.

actualReplyMarkup.progress: Hello, <name>.  Elementals are tough quarry, but I know you're up to the task.  Do you have those bracers of binding?
actualReplyMarkup.complete:
You found them.  I trust the elementals from which you removed these bracers were amenable?

Hm...death has not only stopped my heart, but robbed me of my comedic timing, it seems.

Well thank you, <name>.  You serve the Magus, and hence the Dark Lady, well.

8: Find the traitors and recover their artifacts, then return to Magus Voidglare in Tarren Mill.

actualReplyMarkup.progress: Did you find the thieves?  And more importantly, did you find what they stole?
actualReplyMarkup.complete:
You have done a great service for the Forsaken, <name>.  These artifacts have been sorely missed.

And it is good to hear that Kegan and the other betrayers have found justice.

8: Acquire the Dalaran Sewer Key for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.

actualReplyMarkup.progress: What have you found? An ancient tome? A secret relic?
actualReplyMarkup.complete:
A sewer key? Well, thankfully I am not the one who will be using this.

But we have work to do before it's safe to use this.

lines: Objectives: no longer Elemental Slave x12

8: Kill 6 Dalaran Summoners and 12 Elemental Slaves, then return to Magus Voidglare in Tarren Mill.

actualReplyMarkup.progress: Have you yet thinned the Dalaran patrols around their ruins?
actualReplyMarkup.complete:
Very good.  Those ruins should now be safe enough to search, if one is careful.

Thank you, <name>.
